jsonld_raw.name: ENERGETICALLY NEW YORK EDP 3.4 FL. OZ.
jsonld_raw.description:
ENERGETICALLY NEW YORK EDP 3.4 FL. OZ. Capture the magnetic energy of New York: rhythm, creativity, and constant motion. It evokes the intensity of the city and the contrast between the urban pulse and a weekend getaway, when the air changes and everything feels lighter. Cardamom provides a spicy and vibrant freshness that is balanced by the luminous elegance of jasmine. Sandalwood introduces an enveloping, structured warmth, creating a fragrance with character that is modern and sophisticated.

A collection created by Ms. Jo Malone CBE, founder of Jo Loves.

Woody spicy | Magnetic, vibrant, and sophisticated
